HOW TO · AFTER HOURS
SAMPLE · PLUMBER · LOCK SCREEN
9:47 PM
TEXT · 9:21 PM
Kitchen faucet is leaking. Can you come tomorrow?
TEXT · 9:38 PM
How much to swap a water heater?
TEXT · 9:47 PM
Toilet keeps running. Price?
Texts at 9 PM.
Answered by 8 AM.
5 steps, no late nights. Swipe ▸

slides.title: 1. Say *got it* and when
slides.body: One short auto reply: thanks, and when they will hear from you. Write it once. SAMPLE: “Thanks, got your message. I am off the clock and will text you back by 8 AM.”

slides.title: 2. Ask for the *one detail*
slides.body: Whatever you always need to price it: the model, the address, or one or two photos. Ask in the same text so it is waiting for you. SAMPLE: “If you can, send a photo of the label on the heater.”

slides.title: 3. Give urgent a *way in*
slides.body: A leak at 10 PM is not a price question. Add one line for real emergencies. SAMPLE: “Water leaking right now? Call 555 0142.” (made up number)

slides.title: 4. Answer them *in one sitting*
slides.body: Do the real replies together, first thing in the morning. Only offer times you can actually keep. If you are not sure a slot is open, say you will confirm it.

slides.title: 5. *Claude* drafts the batch
slides.body: Paste into Claude (the free plan works): Here are the customer messages that came in after hours: [paste all]. For each one, draft a short reply using my prices and rules: [paste]. Offer two times from tomorrow's open slots [times]. If a message is missing what I need to price it, ask for that one detail. Mark anything you are unsure of with [CHECK].

cta.gift: Free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice.
cta.small: Free in your DMs. *It drafts, you send.*
